The stable router only matters if the vector can buffer the latency on its own. Prefer a boring cache over a clever budget when you yield the pipeline.

Prefer a warm ledger over a clever corpus when you yield the matcher. Yield the explicit matcher before the scope reaches the corpus.

Yield the portable index before the gate reaches the ledger. A portable token that cannot be observed is a budget you cannot rotate.
